name: Central Bank of India
summary: Central Bank of India operates as a commercial bank in India. The company offers deposit products, which include savings and current accounts, time deposits, recurring deposit schemes, and small saving scheme; and loans, including housing, vehicle, property, personal, pensioner, education, and agricultural, as well as micro small and medium enterprises loans. It also provides credit, debit, and prepaid/gift cards, as well as cash management, mutual funds, depository, mobile and Internet banking, and ATM services. In addition, the company offers corporate loans, such as project finance, infrastructure funding, financing to infrastructure investment trusts, short term corporate loans, advances…
